subject: A mitochondrial transport route helped senescent cells drive inflammation
script: From Agewell Brief: A mitochondrial transport route helped senescent cells drive inflammation. New lab research traces part of the inflammatory output of senescent cells to mitochondrial citrate metabolism, and finds that inhibiting a key transporter reduces that signaling without waking the cells. Inhibiting SLC25A1 reduced inflammatory signaling in cells and aged mice. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
